title: Open a visit, chart a tooth and record what you found
summary: Start the visit from Today, plan a treatment in one tap, and record a finding on the chart.

steps.title: Open the visit from Today
steps.narration: Today shows who is waiting. Tap Start next visit to bring in the next patient and open their visit.

steps.title: The dental chart
steps.narration: The visit is open and the timer is running. The dental chart shows every tooth. Teeth with treatment planned or done are marked.

steps.title: Tap a tooth
steps.narration: Tap the tooth you are looking at.

steps.title: One-tap treatment
steps.narration: The tooth panel opens. To plan a treatment, tap one chip, such as Root canal or Crown. It is saved at once, and you can tap Undo.

steps.title: Why
steps.narration: One more tap records why. This helps the patient understand, and Show patient uses it to explain the plan.

steps.title: Record a finding
steps.narration: To note what you found on the tooth, tap Record a finding.

steps.title: Choose the finding
steps.narration: Tap the finding, such as Caries. Then tap the surfaces and how deep it goes, if you want to.

steps.title: It is on the chart
steps.narration: The tooth now shows the finding and the planned treatment on the chart, and in the notes for this visit.
